params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Reason: The patch includes large unrelated code deletions and additions that do not address the SonarQube warning about moving private methods called only by inner classes. Instead, it modifies unrelated parts of the codebase, such as constructors and other methods, without any indication of moving private methods into inner classes. There are no changes related to the warning described, and the patch introduces unrelated modifications that are not necessary for fixing the issue.
